subject: [FinCore] POC trial - success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fincore.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Lee <bob.lee@fincore.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial kickoff - quick follow-up

Thanks for the demo this morning, Marissa — that was helpful. A couple quick clarifying items from our side so we can get the POC moving: 

- Success criteria: we want to validate (1) latency under typical queries (<400ms median), (2) accuracy on our reconciliation task (top-1 match rate >= 92%), and (3) cost estimate at our target throughput (100 tps). Can you confirm Redwood can provide those measurements during the trial?
- Access: we'll need service account creds and a sample dataset (anonymized). Bob and I can upload to the secure folder you share.
- Timeline: we'd like a 3-week trial with weekly check-ins. Is that feasible?

Appreciate a short recap and next steps so we can align our stakeholders.

— Alice
FinCore, Head of Data Science
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fincore.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial kickoff - quick follow-up

Alice — great to meet you and thanks for the clear asks. Recap and proposed plan below. Please confirm and we’ll get everything scheduled: 

POC success criteria (as discussed):
- Latency: median end-to-end response time under 400ms for typical reconciliation queries (we'll report p50/p95).
- Accuracy: top-1 match rate >= 92% on your labeled eval set (we'll run inference and compute metrics).
- Cost: estimate of per-hour and per-1k-token cost at target throughput of 100 tps, with batching/quantization profiles.

Proposed plan / ownership:
- Week 0 (this week): Redwood sets up a dedicated trial endpoint and shares access instructions. Owner: Marissa. (Attachment: fincore-access-instructions.txt)
- Week 1: Ingest sample dataset and run initial baseline; compute initial metrics. Owner: Marcus (Redwood infra).
- Week 2: Model/serving adjustments (batching settings, KV cache, quantization profile) + rerun metrics. Owner: Rishi (inference ops).
- Week 3: Final evaluation, cost projection, and executive summary. Owner: Marissa.

Weekly syncs: 30-min check-ins on Tues at 10am PT (first one 2026-06-16). If Tuesdays don't work for you we can adjust.

Attachments: fincore-poc-success-criteria.docx (summary), fincore-poc-eval-plan.xlsx (data & tasks), fincore-access-instructions.txt.

Next steps for FinCore:
1) Share anonymized sample dataset in the linked Drive folder (we can accept CSV or Parquet)
2) Confirm the 30-min weekly cadence or propose an alternative
3) Approve the success criteria doc (we can iterate)

We’ll provision the trial endpoint today and send credentials. 

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

— Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
